title: No syncing between NSClients -> AAPS
symptom: Actions taken from NSClient are not synced to AAPS master, for example entering carbs or setting a temp target like 'eating soon', although they are synced to Nightscout. Syncing the other way from AAPS to NSClients and Nightscout works fine.
cause: For one user, the issue was fixed by building and installing NSClient2, suggesting something was corrupted on previous installation. Another user reported that upgrading to NS Dev did not work, but NSClient2 worked.
fix: Build and install NSClient2, which works fine. Upgrading to NS Dev did not work.
evidence_quote: Issue fixed for my case. Built and installed NSClient2 which works fine. Upgrading to NS Dev did not work. Apparently something was corrupted on previous installation.
